item.text: {"paper_id":"paper048","profile_id":"oncology","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"Together, these data reveal the dynamic remodeling of peripheral immunity following platinum-based CRT and identify a delayed peripheral immune activation phase that may represent an optimal window for combining CRT with immune checkpoint blockade.","rationale":"The study directly addresses clinical cancer treatment by profiling immune responses after chemoradiation in head and neck cancer patients and identifying a potential timing window for combining treatment with immune checkpoint blockade.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
